title: Marvelous Designer Collection p05 METAL GEAR SOLID V at GDC 2013 (Fox Engine with Marvelous Designer)
description: From the official MD! Marvelous Designer Collection of Works
transcript:
During Metal Gear Solid 4, we tested some simulation-based modeling tools, but it was difficult to use these tools for any high-res models that required baking normal maps.
However, when using Marvelous Designer on this project, it was very quick and easy to get high-quality cloth models.
In the final scene in the trailer, Snake's stitching on his shoulders was done completely in Marvelous Designer.
No one had to touch it up by hand, and it sure did turn out pretty well, we think.
And here's another demonstration of Marvelous Designer.
It is incredibly simple in Marvelous Designer to set up a specific pattern to get a high-quality result.
Just by setting a pattern and generating the model, the time saved for a modeler is limited.
It is enormous.

summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Collection p05: METAL GEAR SOLID V at GDC 2013 ## Introduction to Marvelous Designer During *Metal Gear Solid 4*, we tested some simulation-based modeling tools. However, it was difficult to use these tools for any high-res models that required baking normal maps. ## Experience with Marvelous Designer When using **Marvelous Designer** on this project, it was very quick and easy to get high-quality cloth models. In the final scene in the trailer, Snake's stitching on his shoulders was done completely in Marvelous Designer. No one had to touch it up by hand, and it sure did turn out pretty well, we think. ## Demonstration of Marvelous Designer Here’s another demonstration of Marvelous Designer. It is incredibly simple to set up a specific pattern to achieve a high-quality result. Just by setting a pattern and generating the model, the time saved for a modeler is enormous. ### Adjustments and Features Here are some of the sleeves being adjusted. Additionally, here are some wrinkles on his jacket being adjusted. One big advantage is being able to manually adjust the simulated result. ## Finalizing the Model Finally, the polygon density is raised and recalculated. The stitching near his shoulders turned out quite well, as you can see from this example. ## Additional Elements Snake's goggles and gloves were both generated in the same way. Here is the final result. ## Conclusion Next on the agenda is Mr. Suzuki to talk about **Fox Engine** shaders, lighting, and camera. ```
